title: Isolate Environments with Terraform Workspaces
description: Runnable Terraform configuration for environment isolation with CLI workspaces: S3 backend with native lockfile, per-workspace env_config locals, and per-environment tfvars.
description_es: Configuración de Terraform ejecutable para aislar entornos con workspaces de CLI: backend S3 con lockfile nativo, locals env_config por workspace y tfvars por entorno.
